note: P4305 (Pro 27:19) — as water reflects the face, so the heart of man reflects the man.

dims.v: self-disclosure — the heart as the true mirror of a man
the heart of a man that reflects and reveals what he truly is, as water gives back a face — the inner self as the real index of the person, deeper than appearance
the heart that shows a man for what he really is

leb (heart) — 'so the HEART of man reflects the man'; what a man is, is in his heart — the inner self is the true mirror of the person. To know a man, read his heart, not his face (cf 27:21; Luke 6:45).
